transcript:
Speaker A (Daughter): अम्मी, कल एग्जाम है इंग्लिश का। हेल्प कर दो। [Mom, tomorrow is my English exam. Please help me.]
Speaker B (Mother): बता, क्या लिखना है? [Tell me, what do you have to write?]
Speaker A: My family essay.
Speaker B: अच्छा, बोल पहला सेंटेंस। [Okay, say the first sentence.]
Speaker A: My family is small. My family have four person.
Speaker B: बेटा, My family has four people. 'have' नहीं 'has', और 'person' नहीं 'people'। [Dear, My family has four people. Not 'have' but 'has', and not 'person' but 'people'.]
Speaker A: अम्मी, आपको इंग्लिश आती है? [Mom, do you know English?]
Speaker B: थोड़ी। एक महीने से सीख रही हूँ, तेरे लिए। [A little. I've been learning for a month, for you.]
Speaker A: कहाँ से? [From where?]
Speaker B: English Seekho ऐप। ₹1 का ट्रायल। एक्सपर्ट के वीडियोस हैं, हिंदी में समझा के इंग्लिश सिखाते हैं। AI कोच से रात को चैट करके प्रैक्टिस करती हूँ। तू सो जाती है, मैं फ़ोन लेके बैठ जाती हूँ। 15 मिनट, बस इतना। [English Seekho app. 1 rupee trial. There are expert videos, they explain in Hindi and teach English. I practice by chatting with the AI coach at night. When you sleep, I sit with my phone. 15 minutes, just that much.]
Speaker A: अम्मी, आप मेरे लिए सीख रही हो? [Mom, you are learning for me?]
Speaker B: तेरे लिए, अपने लिए भी। तुझे सिखाकर जीतते देखना है। पर पहले, आज तेरा एग्जाम। बोल, अगला सेंटेंस। [For you, and for myself too. I want to see you win after teaching you. But first, today is your exam. Say the next sentence.]
Speaker A: My father is doing job in office.
Speaker B: My father works in an office. कंटीन्यूअस टेंस यहाँ नहीं लगता, प्रेजेंट सिंपल। [My father works in an office. Continuous tense doesn't apply here, present simple.]
Speaker A: My father works in an office.
Speaker B: शाबाश! अगला? [Well done! Next?]
Speaker A: My mother... My mother is working hard for me.
Speaker B: ठीक है बेटा, वो सही है। बिल्कुल सही है। [That's fine dear, that is correct. Absolutely correct.]
Speaker A: अम्मी, कल मैं स्कोर करूँगी, पक्का। [Mom, tomorrow I will score well, definitely.]
Speaker B: इन्शाल्लाह। [Inshallah.]
Speaker A: मेरी अम्मी ने मेरे लिए English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड किया। ₹1 का ट्रायल, रोज़ 15 मिनट। AI कोच से चैट करके रात को प्रैक्टिस करती हैं। अब मेरी इंग्लिश भी सुधर रही है, क्योंकि अम्मी सिखाती हैं। अगर आपकी अम्मी भी हेल्प नहीं कर पाती, तो ये बात उन्हें बता दो। English Seekho ऐप, बाहर से नहीं, घर से शुरुआत होती है। और अम्मी, अल्लाह आपको हमेशा आगे बढ़ाए। आपने मेरे लिए सीखी, मैं आपके लिए पढूँगी। [My mom downloaded the English Seekho app for me. 1 rupee trial, 15 minutes daily. She practices at night by chatting with the AI coach. Now my English is also improving because mom teaches me. If your mom also can't help you, tell her this. English Seekho app, it starts from home, not from outside. And mom, may Allah always progress you. You learned for me, I will study for you.]
Speaker C (Voiceover): इंस्टॉल बटन पे क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
summary: A daughter asks her mother for help with her English homework, and is surprised when her mother corrects her grammar. The mother explains she has been learning English using the English Seekho app for just 15 minutes a day. The daughter encourages other children to recommend the app to their parents so they can learn together.
